item.title: George Leslie Mackay (馬偕)
item.description: George Leslie Mackay (馬偕) George Leslie Mackay (偕叡理 / 馬偕, 21 March 1844 – 2 June 1901) was a Canadian Presbyterian missionary, the first Presbyterian missionary to northern Taiwan (Tamsui, 1872).

item.title: Hsu Ling-yun (許凌雲)
item.description: Hsu Ling-yun (許凌雲) Hsu Ling-yun (許凌雲; Tâi-lô: Khóo Lîng-hûn; given name 漢厚, courtesy name 凌雲 — he is known by the courtesy name — style 卓夫; 1862 – 14 September 1944) was a Qing shengyuan (秀才) from 下瓦硐 (瓦硐港下社), Baisha, Penghu; a Han-learning teacher; and an early Presbyterian elder.

item.description: Thomas Barclay (巴克禮) Thomas Barclay (巴克禮, POJ: Pa-khek-lé, 21 November 1849 – 5 October 1935) was a Scottish missionary of the Presbyterian Church of England.

item.title: Tyzen Hsiao (蕭泰然)
item.description: Tyzen Hsiao (蕭泰然) Tyzen Hsiao (蕭泰然, POJ: Siau Thài-jiân, 1 January 1938 – 24 February 2015) was a Taiwanese neo-Romantic composer, pianist, and conductor.
